kernel: measurement/step.c (constant-instruction primitives: branch-free addmod, 6-limb comparisons, selection in the minimum; per-walk anchors; canonical DP exponents; 128-bit fingerprint from key bits 70..197; trail age)
measurement_tool: organizer image via measurement/measure.sh (blst commit f7a88067, GCC 14.2.0, Valgrind 3.24.0 Callgrind Ir), N1=64/256, N2=128/512, MODE sizes 4096/8192
method: Per-step instruction counts of forced-type runs: all-adder inputs (S=0), all-square inputs (S=1024), and the all-adder run with the distinguished-point density set to 1 (DP_BITS=0). The per-step count is the difference of Callgrind totals between 256 and 512 rounds divided by 256 * 64.

reference_unit.charged: 1 unit (the organizer's reference operation; the adder calls it)

sort_compare_exchange_instructions.measurement: 196632 at 4096 iterations, 393240 at 8192 iterations (mode sortbench: one 128-bit comparison and one 80-byte exchange per iteration)

charged.A_units: 1 + (26730.2 - 22996 + 20) / 20000 = 1.18771 (adder step, including the reference operation charged 1)
charged.Q_units: (13511.44 + 20) / 20000 = 0.67657 (square step, including the cyclotomic square at 9804)
charged.events: 66 * A_units per detected cycle (walk-through of at most 64 steps, the check step and the escape)

replica.seed1_512: dump, distinguished-point records, counts, canonical and exponent invariants exact (kernel of this revision)
replica.seed1_4096: exact for the previous kernel revision (the constant-instruction change does not alter the walk)

native_counts: evidence/native-counts.json (uninstrumented, previous kernel revision; the walk and counts are unchanged by the constant-instruction change, as the 512-round replica shows)
deviations: The earlier random-walk c2 (0.1450) is no longer charged: the charges are per step type, measured on straight-line code.
The constant-instruction change raises the adder step by about 800 instructions (about 0.04 units); the charge follows the measured counts.
Memory transfers are charged as the instructions of the moves (exchanges), not as separate storage costs.
The solve/verify/output charge (2^29 instructions) is an assumed bound; its share of W_MAX is 2^14.7 of 2^125.8 units.
